title: Build a Landing Page with AI + Tailwind CSS
description: Use AI tools to generate a landing page, then customize and deploy it
objective: Students will use an AI tool to generate a landing page, customize the design manually, add responsive behavior, and deploy to GitHub Pages

steps.title: Generate the Initial Page with AI
steps.instructions:
Open **Claude** (claude.ai) or **ChatGPT** and use this prompt:

```
Create a responsive landing page for a computer training institute called "TechPath" in Bhopal. 

Use HTML + Tailwind CSS (CDN). Include:
1. Fixed navbar with logo and navigation links
2. Hero section with heading, subtext, and CTA button
3. 3 course cards (ADCA ₹35,000, DCA ₹18,000, Tally ₹8,000)
4. Testimonials section with 3 student reviews
5. Contact form with name, phone, course dropdown
6. Footer with copyright and social links

Use indigo-600 as primary color. Mobile responsive.
```

Copy the generated code into a file called `index.html`. Open with Live Server and check if it works.

steps.title: Review and Understand the Code
steps.instructions:
Before changing anything, read through the generated code:

1. Find the Tailwind CDN link in `<head>` — this is what makes Tailwind classes work
2. Identify each section: navbar, hero, courses, testimonials, contact, footer
3. Look at responsive classes: `md:grid-cols-3` means 3 columns on medium screens
4. Find the color classes: `bg-indigo-600`, `text-white`, `hover:bg-indigo-700`
5. Notice the layout pattern: `max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4` (centered container)

In your notebook, write:
- What Tailwind classes control the layout?
- What classes handle responsive design?
- What would you change to make it look more professional?

steps.title: Deploy to GitHub Pages
steps.instructions:
Open terminal in your project folder:

```bash
git init
git add .
git commit -m "TechPath landing page"
```

Go to **github.com** → New Repository → name it `techpath-landing`.

```bash
git remote add origin https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/techpath-landing.git
git push -u origin main
```

On GitHub:
1. Go to repository **Settings** → **Pages**
2. Source: Deploy from a branch → **main** → **/ (root)** → Save
3. Wait 1-2 minutes
4. Your site is live at: `https://YOUR_USERNAME.github.io/techpath-landing/`

Test the live URL on:
- Desktop browser
- Mobile phone (open the URL on your phone)
- Chrome DevTools device mode

Run **Lighthouse** (F12 → Lighthouse tab → Generate Report).

**Submit:** GitHub repo link + live URL + Lighthouse screenshot.

steps.title: Run Lighthouse Audit and Fix Issues
steps.instructions: Open the deployed site in Chrome → press F12 → click the **Lighthouse** tab. Click **Analyze page load** (check all categories). Common issues and fixes: | Issue | Fix | |-------|-----| | Missing meta description | Add `` | | Images without alt text | Add `alt="description"` to all `` tags | | Low contrast text | Make sure text color has 4.5:1 ratio with background | | Missing lang attribute | Add `` | | Tap targets too small | Make buttons/links at least 44x44px on mobile | | No viewport meta | Add `` | Fix the issues, push again, wait for deploy, and re-run Lighthouse. Target scores: - Performance: 80+ - Accessibility: 90+ - Best Practices: 90+ - SEO: 90+ Screenshot both the before and after Lighthouse reports. **Final Submit:** GitHub repo + live URL + before/after Lighthouse screenshots.
